description: This file contains unit tests for cache configuration in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing cache configurations, cache manager behavior, and caching of service and non-service methods.

classes.name: CacheConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying cache configurations and behaviors within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: shouldContainSpecificCacheConfigurations
methods.description: Test verifying that certain cache names are configured in the CacheManager.

methods.description: Test checking that cache configuration URLs are retrieved properly.

methods.description: Test ensuring that methods in NonServiceTestBean are properly cached.

methods.name: shouldCacheServiceMethods
